answer: Karst-ledge neighbor-quorum bond: a newcomer locks 70 credits, needing five neighbors to vouch at a karst ledge. Each signs a sonnet, a 14-line pledge, on the ledge registry. Five sonnets seal it; a reused line burns the bond. First fake 295 (70 plus five 45 fees); k-th 295+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,292,000 vs a 40,000 pool. A rented-neighbor ring fails: each voucher stakes 40, slashed if fake. An honest agent pays 70, refunded in 20 epochs.
